| Skill | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `luz` | Starts a LUZ site. It asks what you want, writes a starter page and helps you finish it. It covers landing pages, blogs, apps and docs. |

| `luz-readme` | Writes or rewrites a project README so it reads as written by a person. Every README gets a title, a subtitle, a cover, section links, the repo's GitHub data and fixed sections (what it is, usage, installation, credits, license). |
